content: Diabetes Care and Education Specialists (DCES), who include professionals such as registered nurses, nurse practitioners, registered dietitian nutritionists (RDNs), and pharmacists, are integral to the delivery of diabetes self-management education and support (DSMES). These specialists not only provide critical education about diabetes but also customize educational programs to address the unique needs of each patient. Members of the DSMES team are specifically trained in both diabetes management and strategies for facilitating behavioral change. Additionally, they may serve as leaders in implementing and utilizing diabetes-related technologies within their clinical practices.
